The components of ui-components also come for React and Svelte, built on the same script and style sheet as the Wicket ones, so a fix reaches all three. Below, the drop-down rendered by React and by Svelte: the framework renders the select, the shared script draws the drop-down over it, and the framework's state follows each choice.

Both load their choices from a resource this Wicket application mounts, which names the countries in the language of the session, and take the colors of the theme chosen above.
